page_title: TOU 2-0 HAV | Toulouse v Le Havre 15/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.

88' That was a nice football moment. Yann Gboho (Toulouse) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the right post. Arthur Desmas guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!

86' 2 - 0 Yann Gboho (Toulouse) scores with a great individual effort! He makes a good run, skips past defenders and fires the ball from the edge of the box past the diving goalkeeper. The shot went inside the left post. Absolutely phenomenal!
82' That's the end of the game for Yassine Kechta, who is replaced by Ilyes Housni (Le Havre).
82' Zakaria Aboukhlal comes off the pitch to be replaced by Miha Zajc (Toulouse).
82' Here's the change. Djibril Sidibe leaves the pitch and Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) comes on as a substitute.
76' Didier Digard decides to make a substitution. Yoann Salmier will be replaced by Loic Nego (Le Havre).

74' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Arthur Desmas pulls off a brilliant save.
70' 1 - 0 Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) receives a perfect pass and steers the ball into the back of the net with a clever chip over the goalkeeper!
63' It is time for a substitution. Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) is on for Rassoul Ndiaye.
63' Didier Digard has decided to substitute Emmanuel Sabbi and he is replaced by Antoine Joujou (Le Havre).
63' Substitution. Issa Soumare is replaced by Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre).
62' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Toulouse.

61' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Le Havre, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
58' Here comes a substitution. Joshua King is given a rest as he is replaced by Shavy Babicka (Toulouse).
58' Carles Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) replacing Niklas Schmidt.
58' Here comes a substitution. Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) is brought on as a substitute for Aron Donnum.
57' Eric Wattellier shows a yellow card to Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) for his blatant foul.

55' What a sweet touch by Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) as he runs onto a pass deep into the box and fires a fine shot to the left side of the net. The keeper makes a superb save and pushes the ball against the post.
53' Joshua King (Toulouse) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
53' Dangerous play by Joshua King (Toulouse). Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Toulouse have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
48' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. A free kick to Le Havre.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
43' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
43' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) is able to continue to play.
42' The game is interrupted now, Issa Soumare (Le Havre) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
41' The corner is swung in but Toulouse can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
40' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Toulouse win a corner kick.
39' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle after Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Le Havre have a free kick.
37' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
35' Le Havre take a short corner kick.
34' Le Havre seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
31' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. Le Havre are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.

28' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
25' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre). Eric Wattellier saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Toulouse have a free kick.
19' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Le Havre.
17' Le Havre failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

17' A neat pass is well received by Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the top left corner. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Le Havre.
16' Eric Wattellier blows the whistle, Issa Soumare (Le Havre) is penalised for a foul. Toulouse earn a free kick.
14' A cross from a corner kick by Toulouse is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

13' The ball from the corner kick lands at the feet of Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) deep inside the box and he takes a shot. His low strike heads towards the middle of the target, but it's deflected away thanks to a brilliant intervention by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Toulouse are awarded a corner kick.
13' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
13' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Now Toulouse have a corner.
10' Rough tackle by Arouna Sangante (Le Havre). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Toulouse have been awarded a free kick.
6' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle and signals a foul after Josue Casimir (Le Havre) brought his opponent down. A free kick has been awarded to Toulouse.

3' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Free kick. Toulouse will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
3' Referee Eric Wattellier sees the trip by Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Le Havre have a free kick.

2' A fine corner kick lands on the head of Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse), but he is unable to direct it accurately and it flies well wide of the right post from close in. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
1' The linesman points to the corner flag, Toulouse are going to take it.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Toulouse will take the kick-off.
Eric Wattellier is introduced as the referee for today's match.
